sloka: सुराघटसहस्रेण माम्सभूतोदनेन च ।यक्ष्ये त्वाम् प्रयता देवि पुरीम् पुनरुपागता ॥२-५२-८९॥
transliteration: surāghaṭasahasreṇa māmsabhūtodanena ca ।yakṣye tvām prayatā devi purīm punarupāgatā ॥2-52-89॥

translations.english: O Devi after my return to Ayodhya purified by my austerities, I shall worship you by offering a thousand pots of nectar and food in the form of meat.
